verdict.rationale: Google documents user-facing controls to review/delete activity and turn off 'Keep Activity' (gemini-docs-31), and clarifies that regular chats aren't used for model training by default (gemini-docs-38) while audio/video from Gemini Live may be used to improve models unless disabled (gemini-docs-37), implying an opt-out exists for that specific tracking. However, this only covers the consumer Gemini Apps activity/training settings, not broader telemetry (e.g., API, CLI, or product usage analytics), and no independent confirmation that opting out is complete or effective. Missing for 10: coverage of telemetry opt-out for Gemini CLI/API/other surfaces, independent verification that opting out fully stops tracking.
